title: QA board
description: One product's QA status. Lives at .claude/qa/board.json, rendered by ~/.claude/skills/qa-board/render.mjs.

product.description: Product name, shown as '<product> QA Run' in the title and gallery.

group.description: Which portfolio group this product belongs to, e.g. 'apiant' or 'lumiere'. Required for any board listed in a portfolio. Groups must never mix: portfolio.mjs hard-fails if a board's group does not match the portfolio being built, rather than skipping it, because a silently absent product looks identical to a product with nothing to report.

stamp.description: Run identity and freshness, e.g. 'run 001 · 2026-08-16 · fix wave 3 verified'. Shown next to the title.

running.description: True while a run is executing. Drives the live pulse and the 90s auto-refresh. The page also treats any 'testing' row as live, so this is for the gap between starting a run and marking the first row.

runningLabel.description: What is being worked right now, e.g. 'area E, viewer'. Shown in the live chip.

staleAfterMinutes.description: How long a live run may go without a republish before the page declares it stalled, drops the animation and stops auto-refreshing. Default 15.

issueBaseUrl.description: Prefix an issue number is appended to, e.g. 'https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/'.

issuesHeading.description: Heading over the issues table. Default 'Issues'.

lastCommit.description: Commit the board was last reconciled against. discover.mjs diffs from here to find changed code whose rows may now be stale.

items.description: [name, status, note]. name is what a user can do; note is the evidence.
Evidence. Inline HTML allowed, so issue links work.
[time, message]. Newest last in the file, rendered newest first.
